subject: shotgun
leg: control: Valve's own against the brief
label: shotgun, in the place of the game's models/v_shotgun.mdl, models/p_shotgun.mdl, models/w_shotgun.mdl

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/w_crowbar.mdl, models/w_9mmar.mdl, models/w_357.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked D, A, A, A where the asset was C, B, A, C: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: Sides and angle views show one long gun: a receiver with a pump section mid-length, a barrel running to the muzzle at one end, and a stock block at the other that curls into a hook (top, below and front-left views). That matches the brief's pump-action combat shotgun with a stock whose end hooks over. No part sticks out or is missing in any view.

M2.reason: Measured size is 17.1 x 3.8 x 28.2 against the brief's 30 long, 6% short (sizeOff 0.06), within the 15% band for a size the brief gives.

M3.reason: The parts the brief names are present: the pump (segmented section in the left and right views), the barrel, the receiver and the folding stock with its hooked end (visible in the top and below views). The gun has no part the brief names that is missing. Its front sight and magazine base are not named and are not charged.

M4.reason: Black to dark grey metal throughout, with the pump in the same dark finish, as the brief's black metal with a dark pump asks. The lineup's A shows the same dark finish. No wooden region is required by the brief's 'or dark pump'.

M5.reason: The brief names no markings. Panel lines, vents and the slide's streaking in the side views add detail that the brief does not ask for and does not contradict it, so nothing is charged.

M6.reason: Capped at 2 by the line-up test (caught 1 of 4 readings, picked twice or more is the only test that lowers it, so the cap here is the rule's). The judge's picks were D, A, A, A against the asset at C, B, A, C: it passed for a game model in three of four runs. Note: the first-person and in-hand renders look the same as the game's own shotgun, so the picture set may not be a separate asset.

M7.reason: The w_ model lies on its side in the sides and lineup views with the stock at one end and the muzzle at the other, as a world weapon lies. The brief names no front, and nothing is upside down or floating.

M8.reason: The SMAK check reports no errors. Triangles are 174, under the Half-Life third quartile of 187 and well inside twice the median of 138. The renders show no open or inside-out faces on the parts a player sees.

W1.reason: In first-person.png and attack.png the gun sits where the game's sits, held in the orange hand at the lower left with the same grip. Through the SHOOT 0/20 to 20/20 frames the weapon stays in the hand, and it leaves the picture only at the top of the frame, not by parting from the hand.
